import PhysLean.Particles.StandardModel.AnomalyCancellation.NoGrav.Basic
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.FLT.Three

universe v u
namespace SM
namespace SMNoGrav
namespace One

open SMCharges
open SMACCs
open BigOperators

structure linearParameters where
  Q' : ℚ
  Y : ℚ
  E' : ℚ

namespace linearParameters

@[simp]
def asCharges (S : linearParameters) : (SMNoGrav 1).Charges := fun i =>
  match i with
  | (0 : Fin 5) => S.Q'
  | (1 : Fin 5) => S.Y - S.Q'
  | (2 : Fin 5) => - (S.Y + S.Q')
  | (3: Fin 5) => - 3 * S.Q'
  | (4 : Fin 5) => S.E'

def asLinear (S : linearParameters) : (SMNoGrav 1).LinSols :=
  chargeToLinear S.asCharges (by
    simp only [accSU2, SMSpecies_numberCharges, Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero,
      Fin.isValue, Finset.sum_singleton, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
    erw [speciesVal, speciesVal]
    simp)
    (by
    simp only [accSU3, SMSpecies_numberCharges, Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero,
      Fin.isValue, Finset.sum_singleton, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
    repeat erw [speciesVal]
    simp only [asCharges, neg_add_rev]
    ring)

def bijection : linearParameters ≃ (SMNoGrav 1).LinSols where
  toFun S := S.asLinear
  invFun S := ⟨SMCharges.Q S.val (0 : Fin 1), (SMCharges.U S.val (0 : Fin 1) -
      SMCharges.D S.val (0 : Fin 1))/2,
      SMCharges.E S.val (0 : Fin 1)⟩
  left_inv S := by
    apply linearParameters.ext
    · rfl
    · simp only [Fin.isValue]
      repeat erw [speciesVal]
      simp only [asCharges, neg_add_rev]
      ring
    · rfl
  right_inv S := by
    simp only [Fin.isValue, toSpecies_apply]
    apply ACCSystemLinear.LinSols.ext
    rw [charges_eq_toSpecies_eq]
    intro i
    rw [asLinear_val]
    funext j
    have hj : j = (0 : Fin 1) := by
      simp only [SMSpecies_numberCharges, Fin.isValue]
      ext
      simp
    subst hj
    erw [speciesVal]
    have h1 := SU3Sol S
    simp only [accSU3, SMSpecies_numberCharges, Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero,
      Fin.isValue, toSpecies_apply, Nat.reduceMul, Finset.sum_singleton, Prod.mk_zero_zero,
      LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk] at h1
    have h2 := SU2Sol S
    simp only [accSU2, SMSpecies_numberCharges, Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero,
      Fin.isValue, toSpecies_apply, Nat.reduceMul, Finset.sum_singleton, Prod.mk_zero_zero,
      LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk] at h2
    match i with
    | 0 => rfl
    | 1 =>
      field_simp
      linear_combination -(1 * h1)
    | 2 =>
      field_simp
      linear_combination -(1 * h1)
    | 3 =>
      field_simp
      linear_combination -(1 * h2)
    | 4 => rfl

def bijectionQEZero : {S : linearParameters // S.Q' ≠ 0 ∧ S.E' ≠ 0} ≃
    {S : (SMNoGrav 1).LinSols // Q S.val (0 : Fin 1) ≠ 0 ∧ E S.val (0 : Fin 1) ≠ 0} where
  toFun S := ⟨bijection S, S.2⟩
  invFun S := ⟨bijection.symm S, S.2⟩
  left_inv S := Subtype.ext (bijection.left_inv S.1)
  right_inv S := Subtype.ext (bijection.right_inv S.1)

end linearParameters

structure linearParametersQENeqZero where
  x : ℚ
  v : ℚ
  w : ℚ
  hx : x ≠ 0
  hvw : v + w ≠ 0

namespace linearParametersQENeqZero

Original Formal Statement:
/-- This lemma claims that for any two morphisms m and n from f to g, if their homomorphisms are equal, then the morphisms themselves are equal.-/
@[ext]
lemma ext {S T : linearParametersQENeqZero} (hx : S.x = T.x) (hv : S.v = T.v)
    (hw : S.w = T.w) : S = T := by sorry

/-- This lemma claims that for any three objects X, Y, and Z in the overcategory of color C, and for any morphisms f from X to Y and g from Y to Z, the image of the composition f followed by g under the homomorphism-to-representation map induced by F is equal to the composition of the images of f and g under the same map.-/
lemma homToRepHom_comp {X Y Z : OverColor C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    homToRepHom F (f ≫ g) = homToRepHom F f ≫ homToRepHom F g := by sorry

natural_question:
Let C be a colored (multi-object) context with an associated functor F, and let X and Y be objects in the category OverColor C. For each i in X.left, let p(i) be an element of F applied to the discrete object determined by X.hom(i), and for each i in Y.left, let q(i) be an element of F applied to the discrete object determined by Y.hom(i).

Consider the tensor product over k of the Pi–tensor products of the families p and q:
PiTensorProduct(p) ⊗ PiTensorProduct(q).

Then applying the morphism component of μ F X Y to this tensor yields the Pi–tensor product of the family obtained by:
- first forming, at each index, the pure tensor from p and q,
- then applying the discrete-sum equivalence to that pure tensor.

Formally,
(μ F X Y).hom.hom (PiTensorProduct(p) ⊗ PiTensorProduct(q))
= PiTensorProduct (i ↦ discreteSumEquiv(F, i, elimPureTensor(p, q, i))).

  ≫ homToRepHom F ((leftUnitor X).hom).

For tensors t ∈ Tensor S c and t₁ ∈ Tensor S c₁, consider their tensor product prodT t t₁, which lies in Tensor S (Sum.elim c c₁ ∘ finSumFinEquiv.symm). For any combined index b of type ComponentIdx (Sum.elim c c₁ ∘ finSumFinEquiv.symm), the coefficient of prodT t t₁ in the basis corresponding to Sum.elim c c₁ ∘ finSumFinEquiv.symm at index b equals the product of the coefficients of t and t₁ in their respective bases at the indices obtained by splitting b. Precisely,
(basis (Sum.elim c c₁ ∘ finSumFinEquiv.symm)).repr (prodT t t₁) (b)
= (basis c).repr t (ComponentIdx.splitEquiv b).1 · (basis c₁).repr t₁ (ComponentIdx.splitEquiv b).2.

open IndexNotation
open CategoryTheory
open MonoidalCategory

namespace TensorSpecies
open OverColor

namespace Tensor

variable {k G : Type} [CommRing k] [Group G]
  {S : TensorSpecies k G} {n n' n2 : ℕ} {c : Fin n → S.C} {c' : Fin n' → S.C}
  {c2 : Fin n2 → S.C}

TODO "6VZ3N" "Change products of tensors to use `Fin.append` rather then
  `Sum.elim c c1 ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm`."

def ComponentIdx.prodEquiv {n1 n2 : ℕ} {c : Fin n1 → S.C} {c1 : Fin n2 → S.C} :
    ComponentIdx (Sum.elim c c1 ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) ≃
    Π (i : Fin n1 ⊕ Fin n2), Fin (S.repDim (Sum.elim c c1 i)) :=
  (Equiv.piCongr finSumFinEquiv (fun _ => finCongr (by simp))).symm

def ComponentIdx.prod {n1 n2 : ℕ} {c : Fin n1 → S.C} {c1 : Fin n2 → S.C}
    (b : ComponentIdx c) (b1 : ComponentIdx c1) :
    ComponentIdx (Sum.elim c c1 ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) :=
  ComponentIdx.prodEquiv.symm fun | Sum.inl i => b i | Sum.inr i => b1 i

def ComponentIdx.splitEquiv {n1 n2 : ℕ} {c : Fin n1 → S.C} {c1 : Fin n2 → S.C} :
    ComponentIdx (Sum.elim c c1 ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) ≃ ComponentIdx c × ComponentIdx c1 where
  toFun p := (fun i => (prodEquiv p) (Sum.inl i), fun i => (prodEquiv p) (Sum.inr i))
  invFun p := ComponentIdx.prod (p.1) (p.2)
  left_inv p := by
    simp only
    funext i
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := finSumFinEquiv.surjective i
    rw [prod_apply_finSumFinEquiv]
    match i with
    | Sum.inl i =>
      rfl
    | Sum.inr i =>
      rfl
  right_inv p := by
    ext i
    simp only
    · rw [prodEquiv]
      rw [Equiv.piCongr_symm_apply]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, Sum.elim_inl, finCongr_symm,
        finCongr_apply, Fin.coe_cast]
      rw [prod_apply_finSumFinEquiv]
      rfl
    · rw [prodEquiv]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      erw [Equiv.piCongr_symm_apply]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, Sum.elim_inr, finCongr_symm,
        finCongr_apply, Fin.coe_cast]
      rw [prod_apply_finSumFinEquiv]
      rfl

def Pure.prodEquiv {n1 n2 : ℕ} {c : Fin n1 → S.C} {c1 : Fin n2 → S.C} :
    Pure S (Sum.elim c c1 ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) ≃
    Π (i : Fin n1 ⊕ Fin n2), S.FD.obj (Discrete.mk ((Sum.elim c c1) i)) :=
  (Equiv.piCongr finSumFinEquiv
  (fun _ => ((Action.forget _ _).mapIso
    (S.FD.mapIso (Discrete.eqToIso (by simp)))).toLinearEquiv.toEquiv)).symm

def Pure.prodP {n1 n2} {c : Fin n1 → S.C} {c1 : Fin n2 → S.C}
    (p1 : Pure S c) (p2 : Pure S c1) : Pure S (Sum.elim c c1 ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) :=
  Pure.prodEquiv.symm fun | Sum.inl i => p1 i | Sum.inr i => p2 i

def prodLeftMap (n2 : ℕ) (σ : Fin n → Fin n') : Fin (n + n2) → Fin (n' + n2) :=
    finSumFinEquiv ∘ Sum.map σ id ∘ finSumFinEquiv.symm

def prodRightMap (n2 : ℕ) (σ : Fin n → Fin n') : Fin (n2 + n) → Fin (n2 + n') :=
    finSumFinEquiv ∘ Sum.map id σ ∘ finSumFinEquiv.symm

def prodAssocMap (n1 n2 n3 : ℕ) : Fin (n1 + n2 + n3) → Fin (n1 + (n2 + n3)) :=
    Fin.cast (Nat.add_assoc n1 n2 n3)

def prodAssocMap' (n1 n2 n3 : ℕ) : Fin (n1 + (n2 + n3)) → Fin (n1 + n2 + n3) :=
    Fin.cast (Nat.add_assoc n1 n2 n3).symm

def prodSwapMap (n1 n2 : ℕ) : Fin (n1 + n2) → Fin (n2 + n1) :=
    finSumFinEquiv ∘ Sum.swap ∘ finSumFinEquiv.symm
theorem:
/-- This lemma claims that the basis representation of the tensor product of two tensors \( t \) and \( t_1 \), with respect to a combined index structure derived from their respective component types, equals the product of the individual basis representations of \( t \) and \( t_1 \) evaluated at the appropriately split indices.-/
lemma prodT_basis_repr_apply {n m : ℕ} {c : Fin n → S.C} {c1 : Fin m → S.C}
    (t : Tensor S c) (t1 : Tensor S c1)
    (b : ComponentIdx (Sum.elim c c1 ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm)) :
    (basis (Sum.elim c c1 ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm)).repr (prodT t t1) b =
    (basis c).repr t (ComponentIdx.splitEquiv b).1 *
    (basis c1).repr t1 (ComponentIdx.splitEquiv b).2 := by sorry

Let Λ and Λ′ be linear operators on the vector space Contr(d), equipped with a nondegenerate bilinear form ⟪·, ·⟫. Then the following are equivalent:

- For every vector v in Contr(d), we have Λ v = Λ′ v.

Let d be a natural number. Consider the linear maps on real numbers induced by the following morphisms in the relevant monoidal category:
- preCoContrUnit d,
- preContrCoUnit d,
- the braiding morphism β between Contr d and Co d,
- and the left action of Co d on the identity morphism, denoted by (Co d) ◁ 𝟙.

Then the image of 1 ∈ ℝ under preCoContrUnit d equals the image obtained by first applying preContrCoUnit d to 1, then applying the braiding β from Contr d to Co d, and finally applying the left action (Co d) ◁ 𝟙. In symbols:
(preCoContrUnit d)(1) = ((Co d) ◁ 𝟙) ∘ β_{Contr d, Co d} ∘ (preContrCoUnit d) applied to 1.

Let d be a natural number and consider the real Lorentz tensor representation of dimension d. For any component label c and any basis vectors indexed by i in the representation associated to c and by j in the representation associated to its dual τ(c), the contraction of the tensor product of these basis vectors equals the Kronecker delta. You are provided a context, a lemma, and a proof. Your task is to generate a list of 10 related physics conjecture in formal language based on the context and the seed language statements.

The conjectures should be:
1. A meaningful variant of the original theorem: modify hypotheses, generalize structures, or extend scope while keeping the core mathematical insight.
2. Must differ significantly in mathematical content (changed assumptions, stronger/weaker conclusions, or different algebraic structures) but remain recognizably related.
3. The new conjecture should be in formal language.
4. Do not include the proof.

When generating the conjectures, preserve all specific Lean identifiers exactly as they appear in the formal statement. You can also refer to the original formal statement.

Context:
import PhysLean.Mathematics.List.InsertIdx
import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Piecewise
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card
import Mathlib.Algebra.FreeMonoid.Basic

inductive FieldStatistic : Type where
  | bosonic : FieldStatistic
  | fermionic : FieldStatistic
deriving DecidableEq

namespace FieldStatistic

variable {𝓕 : Type}

@[simp]
instance : CommGroup FieldStatistic where
  one := bosonic
  mul a b :=
    match a, b with
    | bosonic, bosonic => bosonic
    | bosonic, fermionic => fermionic
    | fermionic, bosonic => fermionic
    | fermionic, fermionic => bosonic
  inv a := a
  mul_assoc a b c := by
    cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;>
    dsimp [HMul.hMul]
  one_mul a := by
    cases a <;> dsimp [HMul.hMul]
  mul_one a := by
    cases a <;> dsimp [HMul.hMul]
  inv_mul_cancel a := by
    cases a <;> dsimp only [HMul.hMul, Nat.succ_eq_add_one] <;> rfl
  mul_comm a b := by
    cases a <;> cases b <;> rfl

Original Formal Statement:
/-- This asserts that the product of a bosonic quantity and a fermionic quantity is equal to the fermionic quantity.-/
@[simp]
lemma bosonic_mul_fermionic : bosonic * fermionic = fermionic := by sorry

Return the final conjectures in JSON format as a dictionary where:
- The key is "conjectures"
- The value is a list of dictionaries
- Each dictionary in the list has a key "statement" whose value is a string containing one conjecture

Please search and then generate a list of conjectures.

variable {𝓕 : FieldSpecification}

def CrAnSection (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) : Type :=
  {ψs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp // ψs.map 𝓕.crAnFieldOpToFieldOp = φs}

namespace CrAnSection
open FieldStatistic
variable {𝓕 : FieldSpecification} {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}

def tail : {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} → (ψs : CrAnSection φs) → CrAnSection φs.tail
  | [], ⟨[], h⟩ => ⟨[], h⟩
  | φ :: φs, ⟨[], h⟩ => False.elim (by simp at h)
  | φ :: φs, ⟨ψ :: ψs, h⟩ => ⟨ψs, by rw [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] at h; exact h.2⟩

def head : {φ : 𝓕.FieldOp} → (ψs : CrAnSection (φ :: φs)) →
    𝓕.fieldOpToCrAnType φ
  | φ, ⟨[], h⟩ => False.elim (by simp at h)
  | φ, ⟨ψ :: ψs, h⟩ => 𝓕.fieldOpToCreateAnnihilateTypeCongr (by
    simpa using head_state_eq ⟨ψ :: ψs, h⟩) ψ.2

def cons {φ : 𝓕.FieldOp} (ψ : 𝓕.fieldOpToCrAnType φ) (ψs : CrAnSection φs) :
    CrAnSection (φ :: φs) := ⟨⟨φ, ψ⟩ :: ψs.1, by
  simp [List.map_cons, ψs.2]⟩

def nilEquiv : CrAnSection (𝓕 := 𝓕) [] ≃ Unit where
  toFun _ := ()
  invFun _ := ⟨[], rfl⟩
  left_inv ψs := Subtype.ext <| by
    have h2 := ψs.2
    simp only [List.map_eq_nil_iff] at h2
    simp [h2]
  right_inv _ := by
    simp

def singletonEquiv {φ : 𝓕.FieldOp} : CrAnSection [φ] ≃
    𝓕.fieldOpToCrAnType φ where
  toFun ψs := ψs.head
  invFun ψ := ⟨[⟨φ, ψ⟩], by simp⟩
  left_inv ψs := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only
    have h1 := eq_head_cons_tail (ψs := ψs)
    rw [h1]
    have h2 := ψs.tail.2
    simp only [List.tail_cons, List.map_eq_nil_iff] at h2
    simp [h2]
  right_inv ψ := by
    simp only [head]
    rfl

  toFun ψs := ⟨ψs.head, ψs.tail⟩
  invFun ψψs :=
    match ψψs with
    | (ψ, ψs) => cons ψ ψs
  left_inv ψs := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Eq.symm eq_head_cons_tail
  right_inv ψψs := by
    match ψψs with
    | (ψ, ψs) => rfl

    CrAnSection φs ≃ CrAnSection φs'
  | _, _, rfl => Equiv.refl _

def take (n : ℕ) (ψs : CrAnSection φs) : CrAnSection (φs.take n) :=
  ⟨ψs.1.take n, by simp [ψs.2]⟩

def drop (n : ℕ) (ψs : CrAnSection φs) : CrAnSection (φs.drop n) :=
  ⟨ψs.1.drop n, by simp [ψs.2]⟩

import Mathlib.RingTheory.GradedAlgebra.Basic

namespace FieldSpecification
variable {𝓕 : FieldSpecification}
open FieldStatistic

namespace FieldOpFreeAlgebra

noncomputable section

def statisticSubmodule (f : FieldStatistic) : Submodule ℂ 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra :=
  Submodule.span ℂ {a | ∃ φs, a = ofCrAnListF φs ∧ (𝓕 |>ₛ φs) = f}

  Basis.constr ofCrAnListFBasis ℂ fun φs =>
  if h : (𝓕 |>ₛ φs) = bosonic then
    ⟨ofCrAnListF φs, Submodule.mem_span.mpr fun _ a => a ⟨φs, ⟨rfl, h⟩⟩⟩
  else
    0

  if h : (𝓕 |>ₛ φs) = fermionic then
    ⟨ofCrAnListF φs, Submodule.mem_span.mpr fun _ a => a ⟨φs, ⟨rfl, h⟩⟩⟩
  else

natural_question:
Let φ₁, …, φₙ be a finite list of creation/annihilation field operators. Consider the field operator obtained by composing them in order, and then apply the fermionic projection to this operator. The result is:

- equal to the original operator if the list φ₁, …, φₙ is fermionic, and
- equal to zero otherwise.

In other words, the fermionic projection acts as the identity on operators built from a fermionic list of creation/annihilation operators, and annihilates them if the list is not fermionic.

def minimallyAllowsTermsOfFinset (S5 S10 : Finset ℤ) : (T : PotentialTerm) → Multiset Charges

    let SqHd := S5.val

    let prod := SqHd.product (SqHu)

minimallyAllowsTermsOfFinset(S5′, S10′, T) ⊆ minimallyAllowsTermsOfFinset(S5, S10, T).
context:
import PhysLean.Particles.SuperSymmetry.SU5.Charges.MinimallyAllowsTerm.Basic
namespace SuperSymmetry

namespace SU5

namespace Charges

def toMultisetsOne (s : Finset ℤ) : Multiset (Multiset ℤ) :=
  let X1 := (s.powersetCard 1).val.map fun X => X.val
  X1

def toMultisetsTwo (s : Finset ℤ) : Multiset (Multiset ℤ) :=
  let X1 := (s.powersetCard 1).val.map (fun X => X.val.bind (fun x => Multiset.replicate 2 x))
  let X2 := (s.powersetCard 2).val.map fun X => X.val
  X1 + X2

def toMultisetsThree (s : Finset ℤ) : Multiset (Multiset ℤ) :=
  let X1 := (s.powersetCard 1).val.map (fun X => X.val.bind (fun x => Multiset.replicate 3 x))
  let X2 := s.val.bind (fun x => (s \ {x}).val.map (fun y => {x} + Multiset.replicate 2 y))
  let X3 := (s.powersetCard 3).val.map fun X => X.val
  X1 + X2 + X3

open PotentialTerm

def minimallyAllowsTermsOfFinset (S5 S10 : Finset ℤ) : (T : PotentialTerm) → Multiset Charges
  | μ =>
    let SqHd := S5.val
    let SqHu := S5.val
    let prod := SqHd.product (SqHu)
    let Filt := prod.filter (fun x => - x.1 + x.2 = 0)
    (Filt.map (fun x => (x.1, x.2, ∅, ∅)))
  | K2 =>
    let SqHd := S5.val
    let SqHu := S5.val
    let Q10 := toMultisetsOne S10
    let prod := SqHd.product (SqHu.product Q10)
    let Filt := prod.filter (fun x => x.1 + x.2.1 + x.2.2.sum = 0)
    (Filt.map (fun x => (x.1, x.2.1, ∅, x.2.2.toFinset)))
  | K1 =>
    let Q5 := toMultisetsOne S5
    let Q10 := toMultisetsTwo S10
    let Prod := Q5.product Q10
    let Filt := Prod.filter (fun x => - x.1.sum + x.2.sum = 0)
    (Filt.map (fun x => (none, none, x.1.toFinset, x.2.toFinset)))
  | W4 =>
    let SqHd := S5.val
    let SqHu := S5.val
    let Q5 := toMultisetsOne S5
    let prod := SqHd.product (SqHu.product Q5)
    let Filt := prod.filter (fun x => x.1 - 2 * x.2.1 + x.2.2.sum = 0)
    (Filt.map (fun x => (x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2.toFinset, ∅)))
  | W3 =>
    let SqHu := S5.val
    let Q5 := toMultisetsTwo S5
    let prod := SqHu.product Q5
    let Filt := prod.filter (fun x => - 2 * x.1 + x.2.sum = 0)
    (Filt.map (fun x => (none, x.1, x.2.toFinset, ∅)))
  | W2 =>
    let SqHd := S5.val
    let Q10 := toMultisetsThree S10
    let prod := SqHd.product Q10
    let Filt := prod.filter (fun x => x.1 + x.2.sum = 0)
    (Filt.map (fun x => (x.1, none, ∅, x.2.toFinset))).filter fun x => MinimallyAllowsTerm x W2
  | W1 =>
    let Q5 := toMultisetsOne S5
    let Q10 := toMultisetsThree S10
    let Prod := Q5.product Q10
    let Filt := Prod.filter (fun x => x.1.sum + x.2.sum = 0)
    (Filt.map (fun x =>
      (none, none, x.1.toFinset, x.2.toFinset))).filter fun x => MinimallyAllowsTerm x W1
  | Λ =>
    let Q5 := toMultisetsTwo S5
    let Q10 := toMultisetsOne S10
    let Prod := Q5.product Q10
    let Filt := Prod.filter (fun x => x.1.sum + x.2.sum = 0)
    (Filt.map (fun x => (none, none, x.1.toFinset, x.2.toFinset)))
  | β =>
    let SqHu := S5.val
    let Q5 := toMultisetsOne S5
    let prod := SqHu.product Q5
    let Filt := prod.filter (fun x => - x.1 + x.2.sum = 0)
    (Filt.map (fun x => (none, x.1, x.2.toFinset, ∅)))
  | topYukawa =>
    let SqHu := S5.val
    let Q10 := toMultisetsTwo S10
    let prod := SqHu.product Q10
    let Filt := prod.filter (fun x => - x.1 + x.2.sum = 0)
    (Filt.map (fun x => (none, x.1, ∅, x.2.toFinset)))
  | bottomYukawa =>
    let SqHd := S5.val
    let Q5 := toMultisetsOne S5
    let Q10 := toMultisetsOne S10
    let prod := SqHd.product (Q5.product Q10)
    let Filt := prod.filter (fun x => x.1 + x.2.1.sum + x.2.2.sum = 0)
    (Filt.map (fun x => (x.1, none,x.2.1.toFinset, x.2.2.toFinset)))
theorem:
/-- This lemma claims that for any potential term T, if S5' is a subset of S5 and S10' is a subset of S10, then the set of terms minimally allowed by S5' and S10' is contained within the set of terms minimally allowed by S5 and S10.-/
lemma minimallyAllowsTermOfFinset_subset_of_subset {S5 S5' S10 S10'} {T : PotentialTerm}
    (h5 : S5' ⊆ S5) (h10 : S10' ⊆ S10) :
    minimallyAllowsTermsOfFinset S5' S10' T ⊆ minimallyAllowsTermsOfFinset S5 S10 T := by sorry

lemma superCommuteF_expand_bosonicProjF_fermionicProjF (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    [a, b]ₛF = bosonicProjF a * bosonicProjF b - bosonicProjF b * bosonicProjF a +
    bosonicProjF a * fermionicProjF b - fermionicProjF b * bosonicProjF a +
    fermionicProjF a * bosonicProjF b - bosonicProjF b * fermionicProjF a +
    fermionicProjF a * fermionicProjF b + fermionicProjF b * fermionicProjF a := by sorry

- φₛ[n+1:|φₛ|] is the suffix after position n,
- S(fermionic; φₛ[0:n]) is the fermionic sign (statistical) factor associated with moving a past the first n operators,
and a is assumed to be fermionic.

After performing the operation “insert and contract at i” on c, the index i.succAbove(j) lies in the uncontracted set of the new contraction if and only if j lies in the uncontracted set of c.

import PhysLean.QFT.PerturbationTheory.WickContraction.Erase

open FieldSpecification
variable {𝓕 : FieldSpecification}

namespace WickContraction
variable {n : ℕ} (c : WickContraction n)
open PhysLean.List
open PhysLean.Fin

def insertAndContractNat (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) (j : Option (c.uncontracted)) :
    WickContraction n.succ := by
  let f := Finset.map (Finset.mapEmbedding i.succAboveEmb).toEmbedding c.1
  let f' := match j with | none => f | some j => Insert.insert {i, i.succAbove j} f
  refine ⟨f', ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, f']
    match j with
    | none =>
      simp only [Finset.le_eq_subset, Finset.mem_map, RelEmbedding.coe_toEmbedding,
        forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂, f]
      intro a ha
      rw [Finset.mapEmbedding_apply]
      simp only [Finset.card_map]
      exact c.2.1 a ha
    | some j =>
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, forall_eq_or_imp]
      apply And.intro
      · rw [@Finset.card_eq_two]
        use i
        use (i.succAbove j)
        simp only [ne_eq, and_true]
        exact Fin.ne_succAbove i j
      · simp only [Finset.le_eq_subset, Finset.mem_map, RelEmbedding.coe_toEmbedding,
        forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂, f]
        intro a ha
        rw [Finset.mapEmbedding_apply]
        simp only [Finset.card_map]
        exact c.2.1 a ha
  · intro a ha b hb
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, f'] at ha hb
    match j with
    | none =>
      simp_all only [f, Finset.le_eq_subset, Finset.mem_map, RelEmbedding.coe_toEmbedding,
        Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
      obtain ⟨a', ha', ha''⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨b', hb', hb''⟩ := hb
      subst ha''
      subst hb''
      simp only [EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq]
      rw [Finset.mapEmbedding_apply, Finset.mapEmbedding_apply, Finset.disjoint_map]
      exact c.2.2 a' ha' b' hb'

        obtain ⟨a', ha', ha''⟩ := ha
        subst ha''
        rw [Finset.mapEmbedding_apply]
        apply And.intro
        · simp only [Finset.mem_map, Fin.succAboveEmb_apply, not_exists, not_and]
          exact fun x _ => Fin.succAbove_ne i x
        · simp only [Finset.mem_map, Fin.succAboveEmb_apply, not_exists, not_and]
          have hj := j.2

          intro a ha hja
          rw [Function.Injective.eq_iff (Fin.succAbove_right_injective)] at hja
          subst hja
          exact False.elim (hj a' ha' ha)
      | Or.inr ha, Or.inr hb =>
        simp_all only [f, Finset.le_eq_subset,
          or_true, Finset.mem_map, RelEmbedding.coe_toEmbedding]
        obtain ⟨a', ha', ha''⟩ := ha
        obtain ⟨b', hb', hb''⟩ := hb
        subst ha''
        subst hb''
        simp only [EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq]
        rw [Finset.mapEmbedding_apply, Finset.mapEmbedding_apply, Finset.disjoint_map]
        exact c.2.2 a' ha' b' hb'
theorem:
/-- This theorem states that for a Wick contraction `c` of order `n`, an index `i` in the extended set of size `n.succ`, and an index `j` in the original set of size `n`, the transformed index `i.succAbove j` belongs to the uncontracted set of the Wick contraction after inserting and contracting at `i` if and only if `j` belongs to the uncontracted set of `c`.-/
lemma insertAndContractNat_succAbove_mem_uncontracted_iff (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Fin n) :
    (i.succAbove j) ∈ (insertAndContractNat c i none).uncontracted ↔ j ∈ c.uncontracted := by sorry

/-- This lemma claims that for a given Wick contraction `c` of order `n`, indices `i` and `k` in `Fin (n+1)`, and an uncontracted index `j` of `c`, the index `k` remains uncontracted after inserting and contracting at position `i` with some `j` if and only if `k` is the image under `i.succAbove` of some uncontracted index `z` in `c` distinct from `j`.-/
@[simp]
lemma mem_uncontracted_insertAndContractNat_some_iff (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (k : Fin n.succ) (j : c.uncontracted) :
    k ∈ (insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).uncontracted ↔
    ∃ z, k = i.succAbove z ∧ z ∈ c.uncontracted ∧ z ≠ j := by sorry

/-- This lemma claims that for any Wick contraction c over a finite set of size n, an index i in the extended set of size n+1, and an index j in the original set of size n, the dual element of the insertion and contraction operation at the shifted index (i.succAbove j) is undefined if and only if the dual element of c at j is undefined.-/

lemma insertAndContractNat_succAbove_getDual?_eq_none_iff (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)

If we perform the “insert-and-contract” operation at position i, inserting j, and then apply the dual-index lookup getDual? at the same index i, the result is exactly the element obtained by applying the successor-above map at i to j. In symbols:
(insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).getDual?(i) = some(i.succAbove j).

import PhysLean.QFT.PerturbationTheory.WickContraction.Erase

open FieldSpecification
variable {𝓕 : FieldSpecification}

namespace WickContraction
variable {n : ℕ} (c : WickContraction n)
open PhysLean.List
open PhysLean.Fin

def insertAndContractNat (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) (j : Option (c.uncontracted)) :
    WickContraction n.succ := by
  let f := Finset.map (Finset.mapEmbedding i.succAboveEmb).toEmbedding c.1
  let f' := match j with | none => f | some j => Insert.insert {i, i.succAbove j} f
  refine ⟨f', ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, f']
    match j with
    | none =>
      simp only [Finset.le_eq_subset, Finset.mem_map, RelEmbedding.coe_toEmbedding,
        forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂, f]
      intro a ha
      rw [Finset.mapEmbedding_apply]
      simp only [Finset.card_map]
      exact c.2.1 a ha
    | some j =>
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, forall_eq_or_imp]
      apply And.intro
      · rw [@Finset.card_eq_two]
        use i
        use (i.succAbove j)
        simp only [ne_eq, and_true]
        exact Fin.ne_succAbove i j
      · simp only [Finset.le_eq_subset, Finset.mem_map, RelEmbedding.coe_toEmbedding,
        forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂, f]
        intro a ha
        rw [Finset.mapEmbedding_apply]
        simp only [Finset.card_map]
        exact c.2.1 a ha
  · intro a ha b hb
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, f'] at ha hb
    match j with
    | none =>
      simp_all only [f, Finset.le_eq_subset, Finset.mem_map, RelEmbedding.coe_toEmbedding,
        Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
      obtain ⟨a', ha', ha''⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨b', hb', hb''⟩ := hb
      subst ha''
      subst hb''
      simp only [EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq]
      rw [Finset.mapEmbedding_apply, Finset.mapEmbedding_apply, Finset.disjoint_map]
      exact c.2.2 a' ha' b' hb'
    | some j =>
      simp_all only [Finset.mem_insert, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
      match ha, hb with
      | Or.inl ha, Or.inl hb =>
        rw [ha, hb]
        simp
      | Or.inl ha, Or.inr hb =>
        apply Or.inr
        subst ha
        simp only [Finset.disjoint_insert_left, Finset.disjoint_singleton_left]
        simp only [Finset.le_eq_subset, Finset.mem_map, RelEmbedding.coe_toEmbedding, f] at hb
        obtain ⟨a', hb', hb''⟩ := hb
        subst hb''
        rw [Finset.mapEmbedding_apply]
        apply And.intro
        · simp only [Finset.mem_map, Fin.succAboveEmb_apply, not_exists, not_and]
          exact fun x _ => Fin.succAbove_ne i x
        · simp only [Finset.mem_map, Fin.succAboveEmb_apply, not_exists, not_and]
          have hj := j.2
          rw [mem_uncontracted_iff_not_contracted] at hj
          intro a ha hja
          rw [Function.Injective.eq_iff (Fin.succAbove_right_injective)] at hja
          subst hja
          exact False.elim (hj a' hb' ha)
      | Or.inr ha, Or.inl hb =>
        apply Or.inr
        subst hb
        simp only [Finset.disjoint_insert_right, Nat.succ_eq_add_one,
          Finset.disjoint_singleton_right]
        simp only [Finset.le_eq_subset, Finset.mem_map, RelEmbedding.coe_toEmbedding, f] at ha
        obtain ⟨a', ha', ha''⟩ := ha
        subst ha''
        rw [Finset.mapEmbedding_apply]
        apply And.intro
        · simp only [Finset.mem_map, Fin.succAboveEmb_apply, not_exists, not_and]
          exact fun x _ => Fin.succAbove_ne i x
        · simp only [Finset.mem_map, Fin.succAboveEmb_apply, not_exists, not_and]
          have hj := j.2
          rw [mem_uncontracted_iff_not_contracted] at hj
          intro a ha hja
          rw [Function.Injective.eq_iff (Fin.succAbove_right_injective)] at hja
          subst hja
          exact False.elim (hj a' ha' ha)
      | Or.inr ha, Or.inr hb =>
        simp_all only [f, Finset.le_eq_subset,
          or_true, Finset.mem_map, RelEmbedding.coe_toEmbedding]
        obtain ⟨a', ha', ha''⟩ := ha
        obtain ⟨b', hb', hb''⟩ := hb
        subst ha''
        subst hb''
        simp only [EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq]
        rw [Finset.mapEmbedding_apply, Finset.mapEmbedding_apply, Finset.disjoint_map]
        exact c.2.2 a' ha' b' hb'
theorem:
/-- This asserts that for any Wick contraction `c` of order `n`, any index `i` in the successor of `n`, and any uncontracted element `j` of `c`, applying the `getDual?` operation at index `i` to the result of inserting and contracting `j` at `i` yields the successor-above value of `i` applied to `j`.-/
@[simp]
lemma insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_eq (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : c.uncontracted) :
    (insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).getDual? i = some (i.succAbove j) := by sorry

Let v be a complex matrix indexed by the direct sum Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 (i.e., a 4×4 complex matrix written in block form corresponding to the decomposition ℂ ⊕ ℂ³), and let M be an element of SL(2, ℂ). Consider the linear isomorphism contrContrToMatrix between the space of rank-2 contravariant tensors on ℂ² (with complex conjugation structure) and such matrices, and let ρ(M) denote the action of M on this space (the “spinor” representation), and let SL2C.toLorentzGroup(M) be the corresponding Lorentz transformation, with LorentzGroup.toComplex its realization on these matrices.

Then the following holds: applying the tensor product representation ρ(M) ⊗ ρ(M) to contrContrToMatrix⁻¹(v) is the same as first acting on v by the Lorentz transformation via conjugation A ↦ L A Lᵀ (where L = LorentzGroup.toComplex(SL2C.toLorentzGroup(M))) and then applying contrContrToMatrix⁻¹. In symbols,
(ρ(M) ⊗ ρ(M))(contrContrToMatrix⁻¹(v)) = contrContrToMatrix⁻¹(L v Lᵀ).

Then for any integer triple a = (z1, z2, z3) that lies in the set of allowed elements determined by I, the number of occurrences of a in the list representation of F relative to I is equal to F’s intrinsic count of a.
context:
import PhysLean.StringTheory.FTheory.SU5U1.Quanta.Basic
namespace FTheory

namespace SU5U1
open SU5

namespace FiveQuanta

def allowedElems (I : CodimensionOneConfig) : List (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :=
  I.allowedBarFiveChargesList.flatMap fun x =>
    FluxesFive.allowedPairs.map (fun y => (x, y.1, y.2))

def toList (I : CodimensionOneConfig) (F : FiveQuanta) : List (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :=
  (allowedElems I).flatMap (fun x => List.replicate (F.count x) x)

end FiveQuanta

namespace TenQuanta

def allowedElems (I : CodimensionOneConfig) : List (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :=
  I.allowedTenChargesList.flatMap fun x =>
    FluxesTen.allowedPairs.map (fun y => (x, y.1, y.2))

def toList (I : CodimensionOneConfig) (F : TenQuanta) : List (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :=
  (allowedElems I).flatMap (fun x => List.replicate (F.count x) x)
theorem:
/-- This lemma claims that for any FluxesFive structure F satisfying the NoExotics and HasNoZero conditions, and for any integer pair a in the set of allowed pairs, the count of a in F's list representation equals F's count function applied to a.-/
lemma toList_count {I : CodimensionOneConfig} {F : TenQuanta}
    {a : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ}
    (hf : F.toFluxesTen.NoExotics ∧ F.toFluxesTen.HasNoZero)
    (hc : ∀ s ∈ F.toCharges, s ∈ I.allowedTenCharges)
    (hmema : a ∈ allowedElems I) :
    (F.toList I).count a = F.count a := by sorry

Lemma (informal statement):

Let n be fixed. Consider dependent pairs of the form (c, o), where c is a Wick contraction of size n (c ∈ WickContraction n) and o is an element of Option(c.uncontracted), i.e., either none or some element from the type uncontracted associated to c.

Suppose we have two such pairs c1 = (c1₁, c1₂) and c2 = (c2₁, c2₂) with the following properties:
- Their first components are equal: c1₁ = c2₁.
- Their second components are equal after transporting c2₂ along this equality of first components, i.e., c1₂ equals the image of c2₂ under the canonical equivalence Option(c2₁.uncontracted) ≃ Option(c1₁.uncontracted) induced by c1₁ = c2₁.

Then the two pairs are equal: c1 = c2.

namespace PureU1

@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

open BigOperators
end Charges

  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance

    intro i

        j

      if s = j then
        i

        s

    aesop
  right_inv s := by
    aesop

import PhysLean.Relativity.Tensors.ComplexTensor.Weyl.Contraction

namespace Fermion
noncomputable section

open Matrix
open MatrixGroups
open Complex
open TensorProduct
open CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory

def leftAltLeftUnitVal : (leftHanded ⊗ altLeftHanded).V :=
  leftAltLeftToMatrix.symm 1

def leftAltLeftUnit : 𝟙_ (Rep ℂ SL(2,ℂ)) ⟶ leftHanded ⊗ altLeftHanded where
  hom := ModuleCat.ofHom {
    toFun := fun a =>
      let a' : ℂ := a
      a' • leftAltLeftUnitVal,
    map_add' := fun x y => by
      simp only [add_smul]
    map_smul' := fun m x => by
      simp only [smul_smul]
      rfl}
  comm M := by
    refine ModuleCat.hom_ext ?_
    refine LinearMap.ext fun x : ℂ => ?_
    simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp]
    change x • leftAltLeftUnitVal =
      (TensorProduct.map (leftHanded.ρ M) (altLeftHanded.ρ M)) (x • leftAltLeftUnitVal)
    simp only [map_smul]
    apply congrArg
    simp only [leftAltLeftUnitVal]
    rw [leftAltLeftToMatrix_ρ_symm]
    apply congrArg
    simp

natural_question:
Lemma (contr_altLeftLeftUnit). For any object x in the left-handed module (representation) under consideration, the following composite map acts as the identity on x:

- first apply the tensor product of x with the left unit morphism evaluated at 1 ∈ ℂ,
- then apply the inverse associator,
- then apply the left contraction,
- and finally apply the left unitor.

Equivalently, if ⊗ denotes the tensor product, λ the left unitor, α the associator, and c the left contraction, and if u is the left unit morphism with u(1) its value at 1 ∈ ℂ, then
λ ∘ (c ▷ -) ∘ α^{-1} ∘ (x ⊗ u(1)) = id_x,
so the resulting element is x.

natural_question:
Lemma (contr_altRightRightUnit). Let rightHanded be an object in a monoidal category enriched over complex vector spaces, equipped with:
- a left unitor λ_rightHanded,
- an associator α,
- a right alternative contraction morphism rightAltContraction,
- and a morphism altRightRightUnit : ℂ → End(rightHanded) sending 1 ∈ ℂ to the unit action.

Then for every x ∈ rightHanded, the following composite equals x:
- start with x ⊗ (altRightRightUnit(1)) in rightHanded ⊗ ℂ,

import PhysLean.QFT.PerturbationTheory.WickContraction.ExtractEquiv

open FieldSpecification
variable {𝓕 : FieldSpecification}

namespace WickContraction
variable {n : ℕ} (c : WickContraction n)
open PhysLean.List
open PhysLean.Fin

def uncontractedList : List (Fin n) := List.filter (fun x => x ∈ c.uncontracted) (List.finRange n)

def uncontractedIndexEquiv (c : WickContraction n) :
    Fin (c.uncontractedList).length ≃ c.uncontracted where
  toFun i := ⟨c.uncontractedList.get i, c.uncontractedList_get_mem_uncontracted i⟩
  invFun i := ⟨List.idxOf i.1 c.uncontractedList,
    List.idxOf_lt_length_iff.mpr ((c.uncontractedList_mem_iff i.1).mpr i.2)⟩
  left_inv i := by
    ext
    exact List.get_idxOf (uncontractedList_nodup c) _
  right_inv i := by
    ext
    simp

def uncontractedListGet {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    List 𝓕.FieldOp := φsΛ.uncontractedList.map φs.get

@[inherit_doc uncontractedListGet]
scoped[WickContraction] notation "[" φsΛ "]ᵘᶜ" => uncontractedListGet φsΛ

def uncontractedFieldOpEquiv (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    Option φsΛ.uncontracted ≃ Option (Fin [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) :=
  Equiv.optionCongr (φsΛ.uncontractedIndexEquiv.symm.trans
    (finCongr (by simp [uncontractedListGet])))

def uncontractedListEmd {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length} :
    Fin [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length ↪ Fin φs.length := ((finCongr (by simp [uncontractedListGet])).trans
  φsΛ.uncontractedIndexEquiv).toEmbedding.trans
  (Function.Embedding.subtype fun x => x ∈ φsΛ.uncontracted)

Original Formal Statement:
/-- This lemma claims that for any list of field operators φs and a corresponding Wick contraction φsΛ, if b is a finite set of indices from the contraction's domain and lies within φsΛ's first component, then the image of another finite index set a under the uncontractedListEmd mapping is disjoint from b.-/
@[simp]
lemma uncontractedListEmd_finset_disjoint_left {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length} (a : Finset (Fin [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length))
    (b : Finset (Fin φs.length)) (hb : b ∈ φsΛ.1) : Disjoint (a.map uncontractedListEmd) b := by sorry

natural_question: Let φs be a list of field operators, and let φsΛ be a Wick contraction on φs (i.e., a choice of pairings among some of the indices 0, …, φs.length − 1). Let a be a finite set of indices drawn from the complement of the contracted indices (so a consists of positions that are not paired by the contraction), and let b be a finite set of indices drawn from the original index set {0, …, φs.length − 1}. Suppose moreover that b is contained in the first component of φsΛ (i.e., lies among the indices that are contracted). Then the image of a under the embedding that identifies uncontracted indices with their positions in the original list is disjoint from b.

natural_question:
Let I be a codimension-one configuration and F be a ten-quanta object. Let a be an integer triple (a ∈ ℤ × ℤ × ℤ). Assume:
- F’s fluxes satisfy the “no exotics” and “no zero” conditions.
- Every charge of F is allowed by I (i.e., for all s in F’s charges, s lies in I’s set of allowed ten-charges).
- The element a is in the set of elements allowed by I.

Then the number of occurrences of a in the list constructed from F and I equals the number of occurrences of a in F itself:
count of a in F.toList(I) = count of a in F.

Let φsΛ be a Wick contraction on φs (i.e., a choice of pairings among entries of φs), and let k be an index in the set of uncontracted positions of φsΛ. = S(φ, {uncontracted operators of φs with index < k})
  • (contractStateAtIndex at k × φsΛ.timeContract),
provided that φ is time-ordered before φs[k] and i < i.succAbove k.

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

def basisAsCharges (j : Fin n.succ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

def basis!AsCharges (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenShiftFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenShiftSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

@[simps!]
def basis (j : Fin n.succ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols :=
  ⟨basisAsCharges j, by
    intro i
    simp only [succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 =>
    exact basis_linearACC j⟩

@[simps!]
def basis! (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols :=
  ⟨basis!AsCharges j, by
    intro i
    simp only [succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 =>
    exact basis!_linearACC j⟩

def basisa : (Fin n.succ) ⊕ (Fin n) → (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols := fun i =>
  match i with
  | .inl i => basis i
  | .inr i => basis! i

def P (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges := ∑ i, f i • basisAsCharges i

def P! (f : Fin n → ℚ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges := ∑ i, f i • basis!AsCharges i

def Pa (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (g : Fin n → ℚ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges := P f + P! g

def P' (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols := ∑ i, f i • basis i

def P!' (f : Fin n → ℚ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols := ∑ i, f i • basis! i

def Pa' (f : (Fin n.succ) ⊕ (Fin n) → ℚ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols :=
    ∑ i, f i • basisa i

def join (g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) : (Fin n.succ) ⊕ (Fin n) → ℚ := fun i =>
  match i with
  | .inl i => g i
  | .inr i => f i
theorem:
/-- This lemma claims that for every linear solution S in the PureU1 system of dimension 2n+1 (with n a natural number), there exist two sequences g and f, each mapping the finite set {0, 1, ..., n} to the rational numbers, such that the value of S equals the sum of P applied to g and P! applied to f.-/
lemma span_basis (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols) :
    ∃ (g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ), S.val = P g + P! f := by sorry

Let n be a natural number, let S be a linear solution in the PureU1 model of dimension 2(n+1), and let j be an index in Fin n. Suppose S' is obtained from S by applying the permutation that swaps the two “even-shifted” indices corresponding to j (namely, evenShiftFst j and evenShiftSnd j). Let g : Fin (n+1) → ℚ and f : Fin n → ℚ be such that
S = P(g) + P!(f).

Then there exist functions g' : Fin (n+1) → ℚ and f' : Fin n → ℚ such that
- S' = P(g') + P!(f'),
- P!(f') = P!(f) + (S(evenShiftSnd j) − S(evenShiftFst j)) · basis!AsCharges(j),
- g' = g.

η′ = (e₀ ⊗ e₀) − (e₁ ⊗ e₁) − (e₂ ⊗ e₂) − (e₃ ⊗ e₃),
where e₀, e₁, e₂, e₃ denote the 0th, 1st, 2nd, and 3rd elements of the complex co-basis of ℂ⁴, and ⊗ denotes the tensor product over ℂ. Here, each term is interpreted via the identification of such rank-one tensors with bilinear forms (fromPairT).

η = e^0 ⊗ e^0 − e^1 ⊗ e^1 − e^2 ⊗ e^2 − e^3 ⊗ e^3,

The alternating left metric εL′ equals the difference of two tensor basis elements: specifically,
εL′ = Tensor.basis(complexLorentzTensor; [downL, downL]; (0 ↦ 0, 1 ↦ 1)) − Tensor.basis(complexLorentzTensor; [downL, downL]; (0 ↦ 1, 1 ↦ 0)).

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

  fun i =>

      - 1
    else
      0

  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

  fun i =>
  if i = evenFst j then
    1

      - 1
    else
      0

  fun i =>
  if i = evenShiftFst j then

    else
      0

  ⟨basisAsCharges j, by
    intro i

    exact basis_linearACC j⟩

    intro i

private def pseudoRiemannianMetricValToQuadraticForm
    {E : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {H : Type w} [TopologicalSpace H]
    {M : Type w} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]
    {I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H}
    (val : ∀ (x : M), TangentSpace I x →L[ℝ] (TangentSpace I x →L[ℝ] ℝ))
    (symm : ∀ (x : M) (v w : TangentSpace I x), (val x v) w = (val x w) v)
    (x : M) : QuadraticForm ℝ (TangentSpace I x) where
  toFun v := val x v v
  toFun_smul a v := by
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_smul, pow_two]
  exists_companion' :=
      ⟨LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun v y => val x v y + val x y v)
        (fun v₁ v₂ y => by simp only [map_add, add_apply]; ring)
        (fun a v y => by simp only [map_smul, smul_apply]; ring_nf; exact Eq.symm (smul_add ..))
        (fun v y₁ y₂ => by simp only [map_add, add_apply]; ring)
        (fun a v y => by simp only [map_smul, smul_apply]; ring_nf; exact Eq.symm (smul_add ..)),
            by
              intro v y
              simp only [LinearMap.mk₂_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.map_add,
                ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, symm x]
              ring⟩

structure PseudoRiemannianMetric
    (E : Type v) (H : Type w) (M : Type w) (n : WithTop ℕ∞)
    [inst_norm_grp_E : NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [inst_norm_sp_E : NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [inst_top_H : TopologicalSpace H]
    [inst_top_M : TopologicalSpace M]
    [inst_chart_M : ChartedSpace H M]
    [inst_chart_E : ChartedSpace H E]
    (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H)
    [inst_mani : IsManifold I (n + 1) M]
    [inst_tangent_findim : ∀ (x : M), FiniteDimensional ℝ (TangentSpace I x)] :
      Type (max u v w) where
  val : ∀ (x : M), TangentSpace I x →L[ℝ] (TangentSpace I x →L[ℝ] ℝ)
  symm : ∀ (x : M) (v w : TangentSpace I x), (val x v) w = (val x w) v
  nondegenerate : ∀ (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x), (∀ w : TangentSpace I x,
    (val x v) w = 0) → v = 0
  smooth_in_charts' : ∀ (x₀ : M) (v w : E),
    let e := extChartAt I x₀
    ContDiffWithinAt ℝ n
      (fun y => val (e.symm y) (mfderiv I I e.symm y v) (mfderiv I I e.symm y w))
      (e.target) (e x₀)
  negDim_isLocallyConstant :
    IsLocallyConstant (fun x : M =>
      have : FiniteDimensional ℝ (TangentSpace I x) := inferInstance
      (pseudoRiemannianMetricValToQuadraticForm val symm x).negDim)

variable [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] [ChartedSpace H E]
variable {I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H}
variable [IsManifold I (n + 1) M]
variable [inst_tangent_findim : ∀ (x : M), FiniteDimensional ℝ (TangentSpace I x)]

def toBilinForm (g : PseudoRiemannianMetric E H M n I) (x : M) :
    LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ (TangentSpace I x) where
  toFun := λ v => { toFun := λ w => g.val x v w,
                    map_add' := λ w₁ w₂ => by
                      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.map_add, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply],
                    map_smul' := λ c w => by
                      simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply] }
  map_add' := λ v₁ v₂ => by
    ext w
    simp only [map_add, add_apply, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.add_apply]
  map_smul' := λ c v => by
    ext w
    simp only [map_smul, coe_smul', Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
      RingHom.id_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]

abbrev toQuadraticForm (g : PseudoRiemannianMetric E H M n I) (x : M) :
    QuadraticForm ℝ (TangentSpace I x) :=

import PhysLean.Relativity.SpaceTime.TimeSlice

namespace Electromagnetism
open realLorentzTensor
open IndexNotation
open TensorSpecies
open Tensor

noncomputable abbrev FieldStrength (d : ℕ := 3) :
    Submodule ℝ (SpaceTime d → ℝT[d, .up, .up]) where
  carrier F := ∀ x, {F x | μ ν = - (F x | ν μ)}ᵀ
  add_mem' {F1 F2} hF1 hF2:= by
    intro x
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.reduceAdd, C_eq_color, Pi.add_apply, Fin.isValue,
      neg_add_rev, map_add, map_neg]
    conv_lhs => rw [hF1 x, hF2 x]
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.reduceAdd, Fin.isValue, C_eq_color, map_neg]
    abel
  smul_mem' {c F hF} := by
    intro x
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.reduceAdd, C_eq_color, Pi.smul_apply, Fin.isValue, map_neg,
      map_smul]
    conv_lhs => rw [hF x]
    simp
  zero_mem' := by
    intro x
    simp

namespace FieldStrength
open TensorSpecies
open Tensor

open SpaceTime

noncomputable def ofElectricFieldAux {d : ℕ} (E : ElectricField d) (x : SpaceTime d) :
    ℝT[d, .up, .up] := (Tensor.basis _).repr.symm <|
      Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm <| fun b =>
    match b 0, b 1 with
    | 0, ⟨j + 1, hj⟩ => - timeSliceLinearEquiv.symm E x ⟨j, by
      change j + 1 < 1 + d at hj
      omega⟩
    | ⟨j + 1, hj⟩, 0 => timeSliceLinearEquiv.symm E x ⟨j, by
      change j + 1 < 1 + d at hj
      omega⟩
    | _, _ => 0

Original Formal Statement:
/-- This lemma claims that the inverse of the time slice linear equivalence applied to the electric field component of a field strength tensor F of dimension d yields a function which, for each spatial point x and spatial index j, equals the basis representation of the spatial part of F at x, evaluated on a specific index mapping: the spatial index j+1 (with appropriate offset) in the time-like slot and zero in the remaining slot.-/
lemma timeSliceLinearEquiv_symm_electricField {d : ℕ} (F : FieldStrength d) :
    timeSliceLinearEquiv.symm (electricField F) = fun x (j : Fin d) =>
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (F.1 x) (fun | 0 => ⟨j + 1, by simp; omega⟩ | 1 => 0) := by sorry

- (3, 2) when j = 0,
- (1, 3) when j = 1,
- (2, 1) when j = 2.

Let cm: Fin m → C and cn: Fin n → C be two choices of components (indices) for the real Lorentz tensor space realLorentzTensor d, and let f: ℝT(d, cm) → ℝT(d, cn) be a function between the corresponding tensor spaces. Fix a point y ∈ ℝT(d, cm). Consider a basis index b ranging over the direct sum decomposition induced by splitting the output basis into m and n parts.

Assume that the map-to-basis representation of f is differentiable at the coordinate vector of y with respect to the basis determined by cm.

Then the following holds: the coordinate (with respect to the canonical tensor basis) of the derivative of f at y, evaluated in the direction corresponding to the split index b, is equal to the Fréchet derivative (with respect to ℝ) of the coordinate representation of f composed with the basis map, evaluated at the coordinate vector of y, applied to the unit vector in the coordinate corresponding to the split component determined by b.

import PhysLean.Relativity.Tensors.RealTensor.Basic
import PhysLean.Relativity.Tensors.ComplexTensor.Basic
import PhysLean.Relativity.Tensors.Elab
open Matrix
open TensorProduct
open TensorSpecies
namespace realLorentzTensor
open Tensor

noncomputable def mapToBasis {d n m : ℕ} {cm : Fin m → (realLorentzTensor d).C}
    {cn : Fin n → (realLorentzTensor d).C} (f : ℝT(d, cm) → ℝT(d, cn)) :
    (ComponentIdx cm → ℝ) → ComponentIdx cn → ℝ :=
  Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite ∘ (basis cn).repr.toEquiv.toFun ∘
  f ∘ (basis cm).repr.symm.toEquiv.toFun
  ∘ Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm

open ComponentIdx
noncomputable def derivative {d n m : ℕ} {cm : Fin m → (realLorentzTensor d).C}
    {cn : Fin n → (realLorentzTensor d).C} (f : ℝT(d, cm) → ℝT(d, cn)) :
    ℝT(d, cm) → ℝT(d, (Sum.elim (fun i => (realLorentzTensor d).τ (cm i)) cn) ∘
      finSumFinEquiv.symm) := fun y =>
      (Tensor.basis _).repr.toEquiv.symm <|
      Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm <| fun b =>
  fderiv ℝ (mapToBasis f)
    (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite ((basis cm).repr y))
    (Finsupp.single (fun i => Fin.cast (by simp) ((splitEquiv b).1 i)) (1 : ℝ))
    (splitEquiv b).2

@[inherit_doc realLorentzTensor.derivative]
scoped[realLorentzTensor] notation "∂" => realLorentzTensor.derivative
theorem:
/-- This theorem states that, under the condition of differentiability at a given point, the basis representation of the derivative of a function between real Lorentz tensor spaces equals the Fréchet derivative of the function composed with a basis mapping, evaluated along a specific direction determined by splitting the basis index.-/
lemma derivative_repr {d n m : ℕ} {cm : Fin m → (realLorentzTensor d).C}
    {cn : Fin n → (realLorentzTensor d).C} (f : ℝT(d, cm) → ℝT(d, cn))
    (y : ℝT(d, cm))
    (b : (j : Fin (m + n)) →
      Fin ((realLorentzTensor d).repDim
      ((((fun i => (realLorentzTensor d).τ (cm i)) ⊕ᵥ cn) ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) j)))
    (h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (mapToBasis f)
      (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite ((basis cm).repr y))) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (∂ f y) b =
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => mapToBasis f y (splitEquiv b).2)
      ((basis cm).repr y)
      (Finsupp.single (fun i => Fin.cast (by simp) ((splitEquiv b).1 i)) (1 : ℝ)) := by sorry

universe v u

namespace MSSMACC
open MSSMCharges
open MSSMACCs
open BigOperators

def planeY₃B₃ (R : MSSMACC.AnomalyFreePerp) (a b c : ℚ) : MSSMACC.LinSols :=
  a • Y₃.1.1 + b • B₃.1.1 + c • R.1

def lineQuadAFL (R : MSSMACC.AnomalyFreePerp) (c1 c2 c3 : ℚ) : MSSMACC.LinSols :=
  planeY₃B₃ R (c2 * quadBiLin R.val R.val - 2 * c3 * quadBiLin B₃.val R.val)
  (2 * c3 * quadBiLin Y₃.val R.val - c1 * quadBiLin R.val R.val)
  (2 * c1 * quadBiLin B₃.val R.val - 2 * c2 * quadBiLin Y₃.val R.val)

def lineQuad (R : MSSMACC.AnomalyFreePerp) (c1 c2 c3 : ℚ) : MSSMACC.QuadSols :=
  AnomalyFreeQuadMk' (lineQuadAFL R c1 c2 c3) (lineQuadAFL_quad R c1 c2 c3)

def α₁ (T : MSSMACC.AnomalyFreePerp) : ℚ :=
  (3 * cubeTriLin T.val T.val B₃.val * quadBiLin T.val T.val -
    2 * cubeTriLin T.val T.val T.val * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val)

def α₂ (T : MSSMACC.AnomalyFreePerp) : ℚ :=
  (2 * cubeTriLin T.val T.val T.val * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val -
  3 * cubeTriLin T.val T.val Y₃.val * quadBiLin T.val T.val)

def α₃ (T : MSSMACC.AnomalyFreePerp) : ℚ :=
  6 * ((cubeTriLin T.val T.val Y₃.val) * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val -
      (cubeTriLin T.val T.val B₃.val) * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val)

def lineCube (R : MSSMACC.AnomalyFreePerp) (a₁ a₂ a₃ : ℚ) :
    MSSMACC.LinSols :=
  planeY₃B₃ R
    (a₂ * cubeTriLin R.val R.val R.val - 3 * a₃ * cubeTriLin R.val R.val B₃.val)
    (3 * a₃ * cubeTriLin R.val R.val Y₃.val - a₁ * cubeTriLin R.val R.val R.val)
    (3 * (a₁ * cubeTriLin R.val R.val B₃.val - a₂ * cubeTriLin R.val R.val Y₃.val))
theorem:
/-- This declares that the value of the function α₁ applied to the projection of the first component of the structure T equals the negative of the product of α₃ applied to the same projection and the difference between the dot product of B₃'s value with T's value and the dot product of Y₃'s value with T's value.-/
lemma α₁_proj (T : MSSMACC.Sols) : α₁ (proj T.1.1) =
    - α₃ (proj T.1.1) * (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) := by sorry

open Matrix
open Complex
open ComplexConjugate

namespace LorentzGroup

variable {d : ℕ}
variable (Λ : LorentzGroup d)

  ⟨
  fun j k =>
    if k = Sum.inl 0 ∧ j = Sum.inl 0 then γ β
    else if k = Sum.inl 0 ∧ j = Sum.inr i then - γ β * β
    else if k = Sum.inr i ∧ j = Sum.inl 0 then - γ β * β
    else if k = Sum.inr i ∧ j = Sum.inr i then γ β else
    if j = k then 1 else 0, h⟩
where
  h := by
    rw [mem_iff_dual_mul_self]
    ext j k
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    conv_lhs =>
      enter [2, x]
      rw [minkowskiMatrix.dual_apply]
    simp only [Fintype.sum_sum_type, Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue,
      Finset.sum_singleton]
    rw [minkowskiMatrix.inl_0_inl_0]
    simp only [Fin.isValue, and_true, one_div, reduceCtorEq, and_false, ↓reduceIte, neg_mul,
      mul_ite, mul_neg, mul_one, mul_zero, ite_mul, zero_mul, Sum.inr.injEq]
    conv_lhs =>
      enter [2, 2, x]
      rw [minkowskiMatrix.inr_i_inr_i]
    simp only [Fin.isValue, mul_neg, mul_one, neg_mul, neg_neg]
    have hb1 : √(1 - β ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 - β ^ 2 := by
      refine Real.sq_sqrt ?_
      simp only [sub_nonneg, sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one]
      exact le_of_lt hβ
    have hb2 : 1 - β ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      simp only [ne_eq, sub_ne_zero]
      by_contra h
      have hl : 1 ^ 2 = β ^ 2 := by
        rw [← h]
        simp
      rw [sq_eq_sq_iff_abs_eq_abs] at hl
      rw [← hl] at hβ
      simp at hβ
    by_cases hj : j = Sum.inl 0
    · subst hj
      simp only [Fin.isValue, ↓reduceIte, minkowskiMatrix.inl_0_inl_0, one_mul, true_and,
        reduceCtorEq, false_and]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
      · simp only [Fin.isValue, and_true, ↓reduceIte]
        by_cases hk : k = Sum.inl 0
        · subst hk
          simp only [Fin.isValue, ↓reduceIte, one_apply_eq]
          ring_nf
          field_simp [γ, hb1, hb2]
        · simp only [Fin.isValue, hk, ↓reduceIte]
          by_cases hk' : k = Sum.inr i
          · simp only [hk', ↓reduceIte, Fin.isValue, ne_eq, reduceCtorEq, not_false_eq_true,
            one_apply_ne]
            ring
          · simp only [hk', ↓reduceIte, Fin.isValue]
            rw [one_apply_ne fun a => hk (id (Eq.symm a))]
            rw [if_neg (by exact fun a => hk (id (Eq.symm a)))]
            rw [if_neg (by exact fun a => hk' (id (Eq.symm a)))]
            simp
      · intro b _ hb
        simp [hb]
      · simp
    · match j with
      | Sum.inl 0 => simp at hj
      | Sum.inr j =>
      rw [minkowskiMatrix.inr_i_inr_i, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
      · by_cases hj' : j = i
        · subst hj'
          conv_lhs =>
            enter [1, 1, 2]
            simp only [Fin.isValue]
          conv_lhs =>
            enter [2, 1, 1, 2]
            simp only [Fin.isValue]
          match k with
          | Sum.inl 0 =>
            simp only [Fin.isValue, ↓reduceIte, reduceCtorEq, neg_mul, one_mul, neg_neg, and_self,
              and_true, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true, one_apply_ne]
            ring
          | Sum.inr k =>
          by_cases hk : k = j
          · subst hk
            simp only [Fin.isValue, reduceCtorEq, ↓reduceIte, neg_mul, one_mul, neg_neg, and_true,
              and_self, one_apply_eq]
            ring_nf
            field_simp [γ, hb1, hb2]
          · rw [one_apply]
            simp only [Fin.isValue, reduceCtorEq, ↓reduceIte, Sum.inr.injEq, hk, and_true, and_self,
              neg_mul, one_mul, neg_neg, zero_add]
            rw [if_neg (fun a => hk (id (Eq.symm a))), if_neg (fun a => hk (id (Eq.symm a)))]
        · conv_lhs =>
            enter [1, 1, 2]
            simp only [Fin.isValue]
          conv_lhs =>
            enter [2, 1, 1, 2]
            simp only [Fin.isValue]
          rw [one_apply]
          simp [hj']
      · intro b _ hb
        simp only [Fin.isValue, one_div, neg_mul, reduceCtorEq, and_self, ↓reduceIte,
          Sum.inr.injEq, false_and, and_false, hb, mul_ite, one_mul, mul_zero, mul_neg, ite_mul,
          zero_mul, mul_one]
        match k with
        | Sum.inl 0 =>
          simp only [Fin.isValue, true_and, neg_neg, reduceCtorEq, false_and, ↓reduceIte,
            ite_eq_right_iff, neg_eq_zero, mul_eq_zero, inv_eq_zero, or_self_left, and_imp]
          intro h1 h2
          subst h1 h2
          simp at hb
        | Sum.inr k =>
        simp only [Fin.isValue, reduceCtorEq, false_and, ↓reduceIte, Sum.inr.injEq, neg_neg]

          subst hb'
          simp [Ne.symm hb]
        · simp [hb']
      · simp

Let j be a spatial index different from i (i.e., j ≠ i). Then the matrix element of the boost that maps the temporal basis vector to the spatial basis vector in direction j is zero. Equivalently,
(boost in direction i with parameter β)_{j,0} = 0 for all j ≠ i.
context:
import PhysLean.Relativity.Lorentz.Group.Basic

noncomputable section

open Matrix
open Complex
open ComplexConjugate

namespace LorentzGroup

variable {d : ℕ}
variable (Λ : LorentzGroup d)

def γ (β : ℝ) : ℝ := 1 / Real.sqrt (1 - β^2)

def boost (i : Fin d) (β : ℝ) (hβ : |β| < 1) : LorentzGroup d :=
  ⟨
  fun j k =>
    if k = Sum.inl 0 ∧ j = Sum.inl 0 then γ β
    else if k = Sum.inl 0 ∧ j = Sum.inr i then - γ β * β
    else if k = Sum.inr i ∧ j = Sum.inl 0 then - γ β * β
    else if k = Sum.inr i ∧ j = Sum.inr i then γ β else
    if j = k then 1 else 0, h⟩
where
  h := by
    rw [mem_iff_dual_mul_self]
    ext j k
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    conv_lhs =>
      enter [2, x]
      rw [minkowskiMatrix.dual_apply]
    simp only [Fintype.sum_sum_type, Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue,
      Finset.sum_singleton]
    rw [minkowskiMatrix.inl_0_inl_0]
    simp only [Fin.isValue, and_true, one_div, reduceCtorEq, and_false, ↓reduceIte, neg_mul,
      mul_ite, mul_neg, mul_one, mul_zero, ite_mul, zero_mul, Sum.inr.injEq]
    conv_lhs =>
      enter [2, 2, x]
      rw [minkowskiMatrix.inr_i_inr_i]
    simp only [Fin.isValue, mul_neg, mul_one, neg_mul, neg_neg]
    have hb1 : √(1 - β ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 - β ^ 2 := by
      refine Real.sq_sqrt ?_
      simp only [sub_nonneg, sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one]
      exact le_of_lt hβ
    have hb2 : 1 - β ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      simp only [ne_eq, sub_ne_zero]
      by_contra h
      have hl : 1 ^ 2 = β ^ 2 := by
        rw [← h]
        simp
      rw [sq_eq_sq_iff_abs_eq_abs] at hl
      rw [← hl] at hβ
      simp at hβ
    by_cases hj : j = Sum.inl 0
    · subst hj
      simp only [Fin.isValue, ↓reduceIte, minkowskiMatrix.inl_0_inl_0, one_mul, true_and,
        reduceCtorEq, false_and]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
      · simp only [Fin.isValue, and_true, ↓reduceIte]
        by_cases hk : k = Sum.inl 0
        · subst hk
          simp only [Fin.isValue, ↓reduceIte, one_apply_eq]
          ring_nf
          field_simp [γ, hb1, hb2]
        · simp only [Fin.isValue, hk, ↓reduceIte]
          by_cases hk' : k = Sum.inr i
          · simp only [hk', ↓reduceIte, Fin.isValue, ne_eq, reduceCtorEq, not_false_eq_true,
            one_apply_ne]
            ring
          · simp only [hk', ↓reduceIte, Fin.isValue]
            rw [one_apply_ne fun a => hk (id (Eq.symm a))]
            rw [if_neg (by exact fun a => hk (id (Eq.symm a)))]
            rw [if_neg (by exact fun a => hk' (id (Eq.symm a)))]
            simp
      · intro b _ hb
        simp [hb]
      · simp
    · match j with
      | Sum.inl 0 => simp at hj
      | Sum.inr j =>
      rw [minkowskiMatrix.inr_i_inr_i, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
      · by_cases hj' : j = i
        · subst hj'
          conv_lhs =>
            enter [1, 1, 2]
            simp only [Fin.isValue]
          conv_lhs =>
            enter [2, 1, 1, 2]
            simp only [Fin.isValue]
          match k with
          | Sum.inl 0 =>
            simp only [Fin.isValue, ↓reduceIte, reduceCtorEq, neg_mul, one_mul, neg_neg, and_self,
              and_true, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true, one_apply_ne]
            ring
          | Sum.inr k =>
          by_cases hk : k = j
          · subst hk
            simp only [Fin.isValue, reduceCtorEq, ↓reduceIte, neg_mul, one_mul, neg_neg, and_true,
              and_self, one_apply_eq]
            ring_nf
            field_simp [γ, hb1, hb2]
          · rw [one_apply]
            simp only [Fin.isValue, reduceCtorEq, ↓reduceIte, Sum.inr.injEq, hk, and_true, and_self,
              neg_mul, one_mul, neg_neg, zero_add]
            rw [if_neg (fun a => hk (id (Eq.symm a))), if_neg (fun a => hk (id (Eq.symm a)))]
        · conv_lhs =>
            enter [1, 1, 2]
            simp only [Fin.isValue]
          conv_lhs =>
            enter [2, 1, 1, 2]
            simp only [Fin.isValue]
          rw [one_apply]
          simp [hj']
      · intro b _ hb
        simp only [Fin.isValue, one_div, neg_mul, reduceCtorEq, and_self, ↓reduceIte,
          Sum.inr.injEq, false_and, and_false, hb, mul_ite, one_mul, mul_zero, mul_neg, ite_mul,
          zero_mul, mul_one]
        match k with
        | Sum.inl 0 =>
          simp only [Fin.isValue, true_and, neg_neg, reduceCtorEq, false_and, ↓reduceIte,
            ite_eq_right_iff, neg_eq_zero, mul_eq_zero, inv_eq_zero, or_self_left, and_imp]
          intro h1 h2
          subst h1 h2
          simp at hb
        | Sum.inr k =>
        simp only [Fin.isValue, reduceCtorEq, false_and, ↓reduceIte, Sum.inr.injEq, neg_neg]
        by_cases hb' : b = i
        · simp only [hb', and_true]
          subst hb'
          simp [Ne.symm hb]
        · simp [hb']
      · simp
theorem:
/-- This theorem states that for a Lorentz boost in direction \(i\) with speed parameter \(\beta\) (where \(|\beta| < 1\)), the matrix element between the spatial basis vector corresponding to a different direction \(j \neq i\) and the temporal basis vector is zero.-/
lemma boost_inr_other_inl_0 {i j : Fin d} {β : ℝ} (hβ : |β| < 1) (hij : j ≠ i) :
    (boost i β hβ).1 (Sum.inr j) (Sum.inl 0) = 0 := by sorry

lemma boost_inr_other_inr {i j k : Fin d} {β : ℝ} (hβ : |β| < 1) (hij : j ≠ i) :
    (boost i β hβ).1 (Sum.inr j) (Sum.inr k) = if j = k then 1 else 0:= by sorry

open Complex
open ComplexConjugate

namespace LorentzGroup

variable (Λ : LorentzGroup d)

def γ (β : ℝ) : ℝ := 1 / Real.sqrt (1 - β^2)

def boost (i : Fin d) (β : ℝ) (hβ : |β| < 1) : LorentzGroup d :=
  ⟨
  fun j k =>
    if k = Sum.inl 0 ∧ j = Sum.inl 0 then γ β
    else if k = Sum.inl 0 ∧ j = Sum.inr i then - γ β * β
    else if k = Sum.inr i ∧ j = Sum.inl 0 then - γ β * β
    else if k = Sum.inr i ∧ j = Sum.inr i then γ β else
    if j = k then 1 else 0, h⟩
where
  h := by
    rw [mem_iff_dual_mul_self]
    ext j k
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    conv_lhs =>
      enter [2, x]
      rw [minkowskiMatrix.dual_apply]
    simp only [Fintype.sum_sum_type, Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue,
      Finset.sum_singleton]
    rw [minkowskiMatrix.inl_0_inl_0]
    simp only [Fin.isValue, and_true, one_div, reduceCtorEq, and_false, ↓reduceIte, neg_mul,
      mul_ite, mul_neg, mul_one, mul_zero, ite_mul, zero_mul, Sum.inr.injEq]
    conv_lhs =>
      enter [2, 2, x]
      rw [minkowskiMatrix.inr_i_inr_i]
    simp only [Fin.isValue, mul_neg, mul_one, neg_mul, neg_neg]
    have hb1 : √(1 - β ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 - β ^ 2 := by
      refine Real.sq_sqrt ?_
      simp only [sub_nonneg, sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one]
      exact le_of_lt hβ

      simp only [ne_eq, sub_ne_zero]
      by_contra h
      have hl : 1 ^ 2 = β ^ 2 := by
        rw [← h]
        simp
      rw [sq_eq_sq_iff_abs_eq_abs] at hl
      rw [← hl] at hβ
      simp at hβ
    by_cases hj : j = Sum.inl 0
    · subst hj
      simp only [Fin.isValue, ↓reduceIte, minkowskiMatrix.inl_0_inl_0, one_mul, true_and,
        reduceCtorEq, false_and]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
      · simp only [Fin.isValue, and_true, ↓reduceIte]
        by_cases hk : k = Sum.inl 0

          simp only [Fin.isValue, ↓reduceIte, one_apply_eq]
          ring_nf
          field_simp [γ, hb1, hb2]
        · simp only [Fin.isValue, hk, ↓reduceIte]
          by_cases hk' : k = Sum.inr i

            ring
          · simp only [hk', ↓reduceIte, Fin.isValue]
            rw [one_apply_ne fun a => hk (id (Eq.symm a))]
            rw [if_neg (by exact fun a => hk (id (Eq.symm a)))]
            rw [if_neg (by exact fun a => hk' (id (Eq.symm a)))]
            simp
      · intro b _ hb
        simp [hb]
      · simp
    · match j with

      | Sum.inr j =>

              and_true, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true, one_apply_ne]
            ring
          | Sum.inr k =>
          by_cases hk : k = j
          · subst hk
            simp only [Fin.isValue, reduceCtorEq, ↓reduceIte, neg_mul, one_mul, neg_neg, and_true,
              and_self, one_apply_eq]
            ring_nf
            field_simp [γ, hb1, hb2]
          · rw [one_apply]
            simp only [Fin.isValue, reduceCtorEq, ↓reduceIte, Sum.inr.injEq, hk, and_true, and_self,
              neg_mul, one_mul, neg_neg, zero_add]
            rw [if_neg (fun a => hk (id (Eq.symm a))), if_neg (fun a => hk (id (Eq.symm a)))]
        · conv_lhs =>
            enter [1, 1, 2]
            simp only [Fin.isValue]
          conv_lhs =>
            enter [2, 1, 1, 2]
            simp only [Fin.isValue]
          rw [one_apply]
          simp [hj']
      · intro b _ hb
        simp only [Fin.isValue, one_div, neg_mul, reduceCtorEq, and_self, ↓reduceIte,
          Sum.inr.injEq, false_and, and_false, hb, mul_ite, one_mul, mul_zero, mul_neg, ite_mul,
          zero_mul, mul_one]
        match k with
        | Sum.inl 0 =>
          simp only [Fin.isValue, true_and, neg_neg, reduceCtorEq, false_and, ↓reduceIte,
            ite_eq_right_iff, neg_eq_zero, mul_eq_zero, inv_eq_zero, or_self_left, and_imp]
          intro h1 h2
          subst h1 h2
          simp at hb
        | Sum.inr k =>

        · simp only [hb', and_true]

          simp [Ne.symm hb]
        · simp [hb']

natural_question:
Let d be a positive integer, i, j, k be indices in {0, …, d − 1}, and let β ∈ ℝ with |β| < 1. Consider the Lorentz boost along the i-th coordinate axis with parameter β, represented as a linear operator on the direct sum decomposition corresponding to splitting off the i-th axis from its complementary subspace. Then the matrix entry of this boost between the basis vectors in the complementary subspace (i.e., from the k-th to the j-th basis vector with j, k ≠ i) is equal to 1 if j = k and 0 otherwise. In symbols:
(boost along axis i with parameter β)(e_k) · e_j = δ_{jk} for j, k ≠ i,
where δ_{jk} is the Kronecker delta.

  E' : ℚ

@[simp]
def asCharges (S : linearParameters) : (SMNoGrav 1).Charges := fun i =>
  match i with
  | (0 : Fin 5) => S.Q'
  | (1 : Fin 5) => S.Y - S.Q'
  | (2 : Fin 5) => - (S.Y + S.Q')
  | (3: Fin 5) => - 3 * S.Q'
  | (4 : Fin 5) => S.E'

  chargeToLinear S.asCharges (by
    simp only [accSU2, SMSpecies_numberCharges, Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero,

    apply linearParameters.ext

      simp only [asCharges, neg_add_rev]
      ring
    · rfl

    simp only [Fin.isValue, toSpecies_apply]

    rw [charges_eq_toSpecies_eq]
    intro i

    have h1 := SU3Sol S

    have h2 := SU2Sol S

      Fin.isValue, toSpecies_apply, Nat.reduceMul, Finset.sum_singleton, Prod.mk_zero_zero,
      LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk] at h2
    match i with

      field_simp
      linear_combination -(1 * h1)
    | 2 =>
      field_simp
      linear_combination -(1 * h1)
    | 3 =>
      field_simp
      linear_combination -(1 * h2)
    | 4 => rfl

Let i be an index in {0,1,2,3} (i.e., i ∈ Fin 4) and let r be a real number. Consider the canonical map from the Clifford algebra of ℝ^4 (with the standard quadratic form) into the Dirac algebra, and let ι denote the Clifford algebra generator. ofCliffordAlgebra(ι(Pi.single i r)) = r · ⟨γ_i⟩ in the Dirac algebra.
